en: The postcard features an old sepia-tone photograph of a large brick institutional building labeled 'Vänersborgs Hospital och Asyl. Paviljong VII & VIII.' The structure is surrounded by a well-maintained garden with trees and open lawns. The reverse side shows neat handwritten Swedish text, an address section with 'Fröken Maja Utterström, Sundsvall, 29 Forstumalugatan 29,' and a printed acknowledgment 'FOTO. CHRISTIANSSON'. There are also some handwritten and printed cataloging numbers.
